 Chad Summe and Mike Veith – Corridor of Commerce at eGateway Capital (EP.364) Jan 25, 2024

 Today's Sponsored Insight features Chad Summe and Mike Veith,
Partners at eGateway Capital, a Cincinnati based, thesis-driven
firm that focuses on growth stage, enablement technologies that
drive the future of digital supply chains, marketing, and
commerce.

 

Our conversation covers their path to creating eGateway, their
investment strategy and process. Chad and Mike highlight the firm’s
regional and relationship-based sourcing and value add
opportunities that benefit from the importance of the Midwest in
supply chains and commerce.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
